items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Lil' Richard. Uh-huh. ... If you came to town and you wanted to be where that was happening, you went to the Dewdrop.

ctx.x: Yeah. And you know, the people who stayed there at that time. Ray Charles, Guitar Slim. Yeah. Lil' Richard. Uh-huh. Dee Clark. If you came to town and you wanted to be where that was happening, you went to the Dewdrop.
